request.spec:
The header shows the signed-in user's own figures when a person on the sheet has the user's name
(by name or alias, as names are compared): that person's due-total and overdue-total; nothing when
there is no such person.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The header shows the signed-in user's own figures when a person on the sheet has the user's name
(by name or alias, as names are compared): that person's due-total and overdue-total; nothing when
there is no such person.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The header now shows your own figures next to the sheet totals, and all 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

The whole change is in `src/main/frontend/features/header/header.slot.tsx`; no server or database changes were needed.

- **New fields:** "My due" (`my-due-total`) and "My overdue" (`my-overdue-total`).
- **Who counts as you:** the person on the sheet whose name or one of whose aliases matches your sign-in name. Names are compared the same way as elsewhere in the app: spaces trimmed, case ignored. So signing in as "vic" matches a person with the alias "VIC".
- **The figures:** worked out the same way as the sheet's own due and overdue totals, but for that one person. Holds, the cap and the other settings apply exactly as they do to the sheet totals.
- **No match:** both fields are blank.

If two people on the sheet matched your name, the header would use the first one. That shouldn't happen, because the app doesn't allow a name or alias to repeat on a sheet.
